data.body:
Final debug report (rebar-debug):
- Problem: Windows/no-fcntl runtime paths raised `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'flock'` in git locking.
- Proven root cause: `git_locking.py` guards `import fcntl` to `None` (`src/rebar/_store/git_locking.py:56-59`) but `_store_git_op_lock` and `_acquire_fetch_coord_flock` called `fcntl.flock` unconditionally (`:224`, `:316`).
- Proof: local macOS simulation with `git_locking.fcntl = None` reproduced the exact AttributeError before each protected block. After the fix, both `_store_git_op_lock` and `fetch_coordination_lock` enter their protected sections.
- Defect legitimacy/safety: the affected lock docs say best-effort/unlocked on OS faults (`:205-211`, `:340-344`); `alert_store.py:8-15,55-62` is repo precedent for no-op advisory locking when fcntl is absent.
- Defect origin: `42076d367e959` (`rebar-ticket: 9305-b42c-3262-4c58`) introduced the unguarded store git-op flock; `aceb6b6a2261` (`ccd2-528c-b4a9-4b90`) copied/extended it for fetch coordination. Closing with `--caused-by=9305-b42c-3262-4c58`, class `plan_defect`; ccd2 is noted as the fetch-sibling origin.
- Test: `tests/unit/store/test_git_locking_no_fcntl.py` was RED first with the exact AttributeErrors, held out while the fix was written, GREEN after, and a sandboxed defect-seeded mutation (removing the guards) returned it to RED.
- Fix: when fcntl is None, skip advisory flock acquisition and proceed unlocked; POSIX flock behavior remains covered by existing serialization tests.
- Validation: targeted relevant suites passed (`tests/unit/store/test_git_locking_no_fcntl.py`, `tests/unit/test_fetch_common_dir_coordination.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py`: 24 passed); `make lint` passed; `make typecheck` passed; Gerrit 2468 got LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and was submitted/merged as 779449bd19fb. A full local `make test` attempt was stopped after a long partial run; cached failure inspection showed an unrelated live Jira ACLI auth failure outside this fix.
- Scope/caller sweep: `_store_git_op_lock` callers route through `_with_index_lock_retry`/`run_git_write`; `fetch_coordination_lock` callers are `sync._coordinated_fetch` and `git_fetch.fetch_origin`. All retain bounded git/ref-CAS retry as correctness net, so no behavioral dependency blocks the no-op fallback.
- Siblings: construct sweep of `fcntl.flock` found no additional same git_locking runtime call site beyond the fixed store/fetch locks. Parity rule is "git advisory lock acquisition must no-op when fcntl is absent"; library/internal callers route through the fixed core and no separate CLI/MCP surface performs this operation directly. No structural guard added: the existing `check_fcntl_import_guard.py` covers collectability; this runtime behavior is pinned by the regression test.
- Residual risk/prevention: broader non-git no-fcntl runtime behavior exists in other lock modules but was not part of this git-locking ticket's acceptance criteria; accepted for separate triage only if Windows runtime support is broadened.
- Replication: the original no-fcntl simulation no longer reproduces after merged commit 779449bd19fb.
